verdict.rationale: Appwrite's source is published in a public GitHub repository (appwrite/appwrite), and independent community commenters call it an open-source alternative to Vercel and to Supabase-style backends, which supports readable source under an open license. Its documented Docker/Helm self-hosting fits with an open codebase, but does not prove the license on its own. Missing for 10: first-party docs naming the specific license (e.g., BSD/MIT), and explicit evidence of the license terms in the repo.
